subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor and merge this experimental grouped Claw schema and read-only planner before the linked RFC is formally accepted?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded and opt-in, but it creates the foundational core contract consumed by the full lifecycle stack; code review cannot determine whether that product and compatibility surface should become OpenClaw-owned.

options.title: Accept RFC, then merge
options.body: Approve the grouped one-Claw-one-agent contract, complete the RFC acceptance process, and then land this read-only base.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Reduce the initial schema and planner to the subset maintainers are prepared to support before accepting and merging it.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep this PR and its dependent stack open while implementation experience resolves the remaining product and upgrade choices.

recommendation.title: Accept RFC, then merge
recommendation.body: Approve the grouped one-Claw-one-agent contract, complete the RFC acceptance process, and then land this read-only base.

likelyOwner.reason: Their product-model review defines the current grouped schema and lifecycle boundaries, making them the strongest visible owner for the acceptance decision.
